chain.label: Missing/improperly installed horizontal stabilizer actuator lock ring
chain.trigger: the circular wire lock ring, which was designed to prevent the clamp nut from unscrewing, was not present

chain.label: Actuator clamp nut unscrewed from barrel
chain.trigger: the clamp nut that attaches the top eye end and bearing assembly of the horizontal stabilizer actuator...to the actuator barrel had unscrewed from the barrel

caused_by.evidence: the lock ring, which was designed to prevent the clamp nut from unscrewing, was not present

chain.label: Loss of pitch control
chain.trigger: the actuator barrel and the clamp nut are not secured together and become separated, the actuator would not be able to control the position of the horizontal stabilizer, resulting in a reduction or loss of pitch control

caused_by.evidence: the actuator would not be able to control the position of the horizontal stabilizer, resulting in a reduction or loss of pitch control

chain.label: Nose-down near-vertical descent and water impact
chain.trigger: the airplane...entered a slight climb and then pitched down in a nose-low, near-vertical descent until water impact

caused_by.evidence: the airplane began a climb, reaching a maximum altitude of about 1,000 ft msl before entering a rapid descent

chain.label: Fatal injuries to pilot and all passengers
chain.trigger: The pilot and nine passengers were fatally injured, and the airplane was destroyed

caused_by.evidence: impacted the water in Mutiny Bay, near Freeland, Washington, and sank
